blocks.text: some va any — qoida emas, ma'no

Asosiy qoidani qizil kitobdan bilasiz (→ qizil kitob, 76- va 79-darslar): darak gapda **some**, inkor va savolda **any**. Lekin bu faqat boshlang'ich «yo'l ko'rsatkich». Aslida tanlov gap turiga emas, **ma'noga** bog'liq: so'zlovchi narsa **bor** deb hisoblaydimi (**some**) yoki uning bor-yo'qligi **ochiq qoladimi**, yoxud qaysi biri ekanining **farqi yo'qmi** (**any**). Shuning uchun savolda some, darak gapda esa any ham bemalol uchraydi. O'zbekchada bu farq turli so'zlar bilan beriladi: «biroz», «bir nechta», «qandaydir» (some) va «hech», «biror», «istalgan», «qaysi biri bo'lsa ham» (any).

rows: We need **some** eggs. (bir nechta — bor narsa)
Call me if you need **any** help. (biror)

blocks.text: Savolda **any** — neytral: so'zlovchi javobni bilmaydi. **some** esa so'zlovchi «ha» javobini kutayotganini yoki narsa bor deb taxmin qilayotganini ko'rsatadi. Ayniqsa taklif (Would you like **some** ...?) va iltimosda (Can I have **some** ...? Could you lend me **some** ...?) — chunki biz narsani berishni yoki olishni nazarda tutamiz. Mehmonga «Would you like **any** tea?» desangiz, taklif sovuq, hatto «xohlamasangiz ham mayli» ohangida eshitiladi.

items.text: You look tired. Would you like **some** coffee before the meeting?
items.translation: Charchagan ko'rinasiz. Yig'ilishdan oldin **ozroq** qahva ichasizmi?

items.text: Your eyes are red — has **something** happened?
Have you got **any** questions about the contract?

blocks.text: any — inkor ma'nosi bor so'zlardan keyin

**any** faqat not bilan emas, ma'nosi inkorga yaqin so'zlardan keyin ham ishlatiladi: **never**, **without**, **hardly** (deyarli ... yo'q), **rarely**, **refuse**. Shuningdek **if** dan keyin: shart gapda narsa bor-yo'qligi ochiq qoladi. **hardly any** — «deyarli yo'q»: There's **hardly any** milk left — Sut deyarli qolmadi. O'zbekchada bu yerda ko'pincha «biror», «hech qanday» ishlatiladi.

items.translation: U hech kimga **hech narsa demasdan** chiqib ketdi.

items.text: There were **hardly any** people at the concert because of the storm.
items.translation: Bo'ron tufayli konsertda **deyarli hech kim yo'q edi**.

items.text: **If** you have **any** problems with the software, call our support team.
items.translation: Dasturda **biror** muammo **chiqsa**, yordam xizmatimizga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

blocks.text: Darak gapda **any** butunlay boshqa ma'no beradi: «**istalgan**, **qaysi biri bo'lsa ham** — farqi yo'q». Bu ma'noda any ko'pincha **birlikdagi** sanaladigan ot bilan keladi va urg'u oladi: You can take **any** bus from here — Bu yerdan **istalgan** avtobusga chiqavering (hammasi markazga boradi). Xuddi shunday **anybody / anyone** — «kim bo'lsa ham», **anything** — «nima bo'lsa ham», **anywhere** — «qayer bo'lsa ham». Taqqoslang: **some** — aniq bitta, lekin nomi aytilmagan; **any** — tanlov erkin, hammasi to'g'ri keladi.

rows: **Anybody** can call this number. (kim bo'lsa ham)
I'm so hungry — I'll eat **anything**. (nima bo'lsa ham)
**Any** shop will sell you a SIM card. (istalgani)

items.text: Come and see me **any** time — I'm at home all day.
This exercise is so easy that **anybody** can do it.
items.translation: Bu mashq shunchalik osonki, uni **har kim** bajara oladi.

items.text: I need a holiday — **anywhere** is better than this office!
items.translation: Menga dam olish kerak — bu ofisdan **qayer bo'lsa ham** yaxshi!

blocks.text: **some** birlikdagi sanaladigan ot bilan kelsa, «biroz» emas, «**qandaydir, allaqanday**» degan ma'noni beradi: narsa yoki odam bor, lekin so'zlovchi uni bilmaydi yoki uning uchun muhim emas. **Some** man from the bank phoned — Bankdan **allaqanday** bir kishi qo'ng'iroq qildi. Bu shakl ko'pincha biroz befarqlik ohangiga ega. Turg'un iboralar: **for some reason** (negadir), **some day** (qachondir, kelajakda), **some time** (bir payt; yoki ancha vaqt).
Otsiz some / any va qo'shma so'zlar

some va any ning barcha qoidalari **somebody / someone, something, somewhere** va **anybody / anyone, anything, anywhere** ga ham tegishli. Ot takrorlanmasligi uchun some / any otsiz ham ishlatiladi: I need stamps — have you got **any**? Aniq guruhdan qism haqida gapirganda esa **some of / any of** + the / my / them keladi (→ 88-dars). Inkor so'zlar — no, none, nobody, nothing — keyingi darsda (→ 86-dars).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I don't have no money» → I don't have **any** money / I have **no** money (inglizchada bitta inkor, → 86-dars); «I didn't see somebody» → I didn't see **anybody**; «Anybody can't help me» → **Nobody** can help me (inkor any dan oldin turishi kerak); mehmonga «Would you like any tea?» → Would you like **some** tea?; «Any students came» («hech kim kelmadi» ma'nosida) → **No** students came.

O'zingizdan so'rang: «Narsa **bor** deb o'ylayapmanmi yoki uni taklif qilyapmanmi?» → **some**. «Bor-yo'qligini bilmayman» yoki «**farqi yo'q**» → **any**. O'zbekchaga «istalgan», «har qanday», «kim bo'lsa ham» deb tarjima qilinadigan joyda doim **any**.

rows: any — if, without, never, hardly dan keyin

examples.title: **some** and **any**: positive and negative
examples.description: Darak gapda some (biroz, bir nechta), inkorda any (hech). Bir gapning o'zida ikkalasi ham bor — farqni his qilish uchun. Inkor gapda ham some bo'lishi mumkin: «ba'zi» ma'nosida.

sentences.text: We've got **some** rice, but there isn't **any** meat for the plov.
sentences.translation: **Biroz** guruchimiz bor, lekin palovga **hech qanday** go'sht yo'q.

sentences.text: I made **some** new friends at the conference in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Edinburgdagi konferensiyada **bir nechta** yangi do'st orttirdim.

sentences.text: Sorry, I haven't got **any** cash on me — can I pay by card?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, yonimda **umuman** naqd pul yo'q — karta bilan to'lasam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Dilnoza found **some** useful articles for her thesis online.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza dissertatsiyasi uchun internetdan **bir nechta** foydali maqola topdi.

sentences.text: The new manager didn't make **any** changes in his first month.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer birinchi oyida **hech qanday** o'zgarish qilmadi.

sentences.text: There's **some** soup in the fridge if you get hungry later.
sentences.translation: Keyinroq qorning ochsa, muzlatkichda **ozroq** sho'rva bor.

sentences.text: **Some** people in our office don't drink coffee at all.
sentences.translation: Ofisimizdagi **ba'zi** odamlar umuman qahva ichmaydi.

sentences.text: Our neighbours have two dogs, but we don't have **any** pets.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimizning ikkita iti bor, bizda esa **hech qanday** uy hayvoni yo'q.

sentences.text: Aziz bought **some** souvenirs in Bukhara, but he didn't buy **any** carpets because they were too expensive.
sentences.translation: Aziz Buxorodan **bir nechta** esdalik sovg'a oldi, lekin **birorta ham** gilam olmadi, chunki ular juda qimmat edi.

sentences.text: I wanted to read the report on the train, but there wasn't **any** signal, so I couldn't download it.
sentences.translation: Poyezdda hisobotni o'qimoqchi edim, lekin **umuman** aloqa yo'q edi, shuning uchun uni yuklab ololmadim.

examples.title: Questions: open **any** or hopeful **some**?
examples.description: Savolda any — javob noma'lum, savol neytral. some — so'zlovchi «ha» javobini kutadi yoki narsa bor deb taxmin qiladi (qizargan ko'z, javobsiz qo'ng'iroq).

sentences.text: Are there **any** good restaurants near your hotel in Manchester?
sentences.translation: Manchesterdagi mehmonxonangiz yaqinida **biror** yaxshi restoran bormi?

sentences.text: Did you get **any** messages while I was out?
sentences.translation: Men yo'qligimda **biror** xabar keldimi?

sentences.text: Have you had **any** news from Bekzod since he moved to Seoul?
sentences.translation: Bekzod Seulga ko'chib ketganidan beri undan **biror** xabar oldingizmi?

sentences.text: You look worried. Is there **some** problem with your visa?
sentences.translation: Xavotirdasiz. Vizangiz bilan **qandaydir** muammo bormi?

sentences.text: Did **somebody** call me? There's a missed call on my phone.
sentences.translation: **Kimdir** menga qo'ng'iroq qildimi? Telefonimda javobsiz qo'ng'iroq bor.

sentences.text: Your hands are shaking — has **something** happened at work?
sentences.translation: Qo'llaringiz titrayapti — ishda **biror narsa** bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: Do you have **any** experience of working with small children?
sentences.translation: Kichik bolalar bilan ishlash bo'yicha **biror** tajribangiz bormi?

sentences.text: Is there **any** milk left, or should I buy some on the way home?
sentences.translation: **Ozroq** bo'lsa ham sut qolganmi yoki uyga ketayotib olib kelaymi?

sentences.text: Didn't you bring **some** photos from your trip to Khiva? I'd love to see them.
sentences.translation: Xivaga sayohatingizdan **bir nechta** surat olib kelmadingizmi? Ko'rishni juda xohlardim.

sentences.text: Are there **any** tickets left for Saturday, or has the concert sold out?
sentences.translation: Shanba kungi konsertga **biror** chipta qolganmi yoki hammasi sotilib bo'lganmi?

examples.title: Offers and requests: Would you like **some** ...?
examples.description: Taklif va iltimosda some — chunki narsani berish yoki olishni nazarda tutamiz va «ha» javobini kutamiz. Bu yerda any sovuq va g'alati eshitiladi.

sentences.text: Would you like **some** more tea, or shall I make coffee?
sentences.translation: Yana **ozroq** choy quyaymi yoki qahva qilib beraymi?

sentences.text: Could I have **some** water, please? My throat is really dry.
sentences.translation: **Ozroq** suv bera olasizmi? Tomog'im qurib ketdi.

sentences.text: Can you lend me **some** money until Friday? I'll pay you back.
sentences.translation: Jumagacha **ozroq** pul qarz berib turolasizmi? Qaytarib beraman.

sentences.text: Why don't you take **some** of these apples home with you?
sentences.translation: Bu olmalardan **bir nechtasini** uyga olib ketsangiz-chi?

sentences.text: Shall I pack **some** snacks for the long drive to Fergana?
sentences.translation: Farg'onagacha uzoq yo'lga **biror** yegulik solib qo'yaymi?

sentences.text: Let me give you **some** advice before your first job interview.
sentences.translation: Birinchi ish suhbatingizdan oldin sizga **bir oz** maslahat beray.

sentences.text: Do you want **some** help with those heavy bags, Mrs Brown?
sentences.translation: Braun xonim, o'sha og'ir sumkalarni ko'tarishga **yordamlashib yuboraymi**?

sentences.text: Kate, could you send me **some** information about the course fees?
sentences.translation: Keyt, menga kurs to'lovlari haqida **biroz** ma'lumot yubora olasizmi?

sentences.text: Would you like **some** cake? Madina baked it this morning.
sentences.translation: **Ozgina** tort yeysizmi? Madina uni bugun ertalab pishirdi.

sentences.text: Can I offer you **some** dessert, or are you too full after the plov?
sentences.translation: Sizga **biroz** shirinlik taklif qilsam maylimi yoki palovdan keyin to'yib qoldingizmi?

examples.title: **any** after if, without, never, hardly
examples.description: any faqat not dan keyin emas: if (shart), without, never, hardly, rarely, refuse kabi inkor ma'nosidagi so'zlardan keyin ham keladi.

sentences.text: **If** you have **any** questions after the lecture, send me an email.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruzadan keyin **biror** savolingiz **bo'lsa**, menga elektron xat yuboring.

sentences.text: Nilufar finished the marathon **without any** help from her coach.
sentences.translation: Nilufar marafonni murabbiyining **hech qanday** yordamisiz yugurib tugatdi.

sentences.text: There's **hardly any** petrol in the tank, so we need to stop soon.
sentences.translation: Bakda benzin **deyarli qolmadi**, tez orada to'xtashimiz kerak.

sentences.text: I've **never** had **any** problems with this airline.
sentences.translation: Bu aviakompaniya bilan **hech qachon hech qanday** muammom bo'lmagan.

sentences.text: Let me know **if** you hear **anything** about the new timetable.
sentences.translation: Yangi jadval haqida **biror narsa** eshitsangiz, menga xabar bering.

sentences.text: The suspect **refused** to answer **any** questions without a lawyer.
sentences.translation: Gumonlanuvchi advokatsiz **birorta ham** savolga javob berishdan bosh tortdi.

sentences.text: Jasur passed his driving test **without any** difficulty.
sentences.translation: Jasur haydovchilik imtihonidan **hech qanday** qiyinchiliksiz o'tdi.

sentences.text: **Hardly anybody** came to the meeting because of the heavy snow.
sentences.translation: Qalin qor tufayli yig'ilishga **deyarli hech kim** kelmadi.

sentences.text: We **rarely** get **any** visitors in winter, so the village is very quiet.
sentences.translation: Qishda bizga **deyarli hech kim** kelmaydi, shuning uchun qishloq juda sokin bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **If** there's **any** cake left after the party, save me a piece.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatdan keyin **ozgina** bo'lsa ham tort qolsa, menga bir bo'lak olib qo'y.

examples.title: **any** = it doesn't matter which
examples.description: Darak gapda any — «istalgan, qaysi biri bo'lsa ham». Ko'pincha birlikdagi ot bilan: any bus, any day, any time, any doctor.

sentences.text: You can catch **any** bus from this stop — they all go to the station.
sentences.translation: Bu bekatdan **istalgan** avtobusga chiqavering — hammasi vokzalga boradi.

sentences.text: Call me **any** time — I usually go to bed very late.
sentences.translation: Menga **istalgan vaqtda** qo'ng'iroq qiling — odatda juda kech yotaman.

sentences.text: **Any** doctor will tell you that sleep is important for your health.
sentences.translation: **Har qanday** shifokor sizga uyqu sog'liq uchun muhim ekanini aytadi.

sentences.text: Choose **any** card from the pack, but don't show it to me.
sentences.translation: Dastadan **istalgan** kartani tanlang, lekin uni menga ko'rsatmang.

sentences.text: We can meet on **any** day next week except Tuesday.
sentences.translation: Kelasi hafta seshanbadan boshqa **istalgan kuni** uchrashishimiz mumkin.

sentences.text: This charger works with **any** laptop, so you don't need a special one.
sentences.translation: Bu quvvatlagich **har qanday** noutbuk bilan ishlaydi, maxsusi kerak emas.

sentences.text: In Samarkand, **any** taxi driver can take you to the Registan.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda **istalgan** taksi haydovchisi sizni Registonga olib bora oladi.

sentences.text: Which pen shall I use for the form? — **Any** one, it doesn't matter.
sentences.translation: Anketani qaysi ruchka bilan to'ldiray? — **Istalgani** bilan, farqi yo'q.

sentences.text: It's a simple recipe — you can use **any** kind of rice you have at home.
sentences.translation: Bu oddiy retsept — uyingizda bor **istalgan** turdagi guruchni ishlatsangiz bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **Any** student who misses more than three classes will have to repeat the course.
sentences.translation: Uchta darsdan ortiq qoldirgan **har qanday** talaba kursni qaytadan o'qishi kerak bo'ladi.

examples.title: **anybody**, **anything**, **anywhere**: no matter who
examples.description: Darak gapda anybody / anyone — «kim bo'lsa ham», anything — «nima bo'lsa ham», anywhere — «qayer bo'lsa ham». Ma'nosi — «farqi yo'q, hammasi bo'ladi».

sentences.text: This online course is free, so **anyone** can join it.
sentences.translation: Bu onlayn kurs bepul, shuning uchun unga **har kim** qo'shila oladi.

sentences.text: I'm starving — I could eat **anything** right now!
sentences.translation: Qornim juda och — hozir **nima bo'lsa ham** yeyverardim!

sentences.text: Sit **anywhere** you like; the seats aren't numbered tonight.
sentences.translation: **Xohlagan joyingizga** o'tiring, bugun o'rindiqlar raqamlanmagan.

sentences.text: **Anybody** with a valid passport can apply for this visa online.
sentences.translation: Amaldagi pasporti bor **har kim** bu vizaga onlayn ariza bera oladi.

sentences.text: Emma is so friendly that she can talk to **anybody** about **anything**.
sentences.translation: Emma shunchalik xushmuomalaki, **har kim** bilan **har narsa** haqida gaplasha oladi.

sentences.text: With this app you can work from **anywhere**, even from a café in Khiva.
sentences.translation: Bu ilova bilan **istalgan joydan**, hatto Xivadagi kafedan ham ishlay olasiz.

sentences.text: Ask me **anything** about football — I know all the results.
sentences.translation: Futbol haqida **nima xohlasangiz** so'rang — barcha natijalarni bilaman.

sentences.text: James would do **anything** to get a ticket for the final.
sentences.translation: Jeyms finalga chipta olish uchun **har narsaga** tayyor.

sentences.text: It's a really easy game, and **anyone** can learn it in five minutes.
sentences.translation: Bu juda oson o'yin, uni **har kim** besh daqiqada o'rganib oladi.

sentences.text: For my birthday, **anywhere** with good food and live music will be fine.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kunim uchun mazali ovqat va jonli musiqa bor **istalgan joy** bo'laveradi.

examples.title: **some** = an unknown one: some man, for some reason
examples.description: some + birlikdagi ot — «qandaydir, allaqanday» (nomi noma'lum yoki muhim emas). Turg'un iboralar: for some reason (negadir), some day (qachondir), for some time (ancha vaqtdan beri).

sentences.text: **Some** man from the council phoned while you were out.
sentences.translation: Siz yo'qligingizda hokimiyatdan **allaqanday** bir kishi qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: **For some reason**, my laptop won't connect to the office Wi-Fi.
sentences.translation: **Negadir** noutbukim ofisdagi Wi-Fi ga ulanmayapti.

sentences.text: Oliver read about it in **some** magazine, but he can't remember which one.
sentences.translation: Oliver bu haqda **qandaydir** jurnalda o'qigan, lekin qaysi biri ekanini eslay olmaydi.

sentences.text: **Some day** I'd like to walk across Scotland from coast to coast.
sentences.translation: **Qachondir** Shotlandiyani bir qirg'oqdan ikkinchisigacha piyoda kesib o'tmoqchiman.

sentences.text: Sarah is staying with **some** friend in Oxford — I don't know her name.
sentences.translation: Sara Oksfordda **qandaydir** dugonasinikida turibdi — ismini bilmayman.

sentences.text: There must be **some** mistake — I didn't order three pizzas!
sentences.translation: Bu yerda **qandaydir** xato bor shekilli — men uchta pitsa buyurtma qilmaganman!

sentences.text: I've been thinking about it **for some time**, and I've decided to resign.
sentences.translation: Bu haqda **anchadan beri** o'ylab yurgandim va ishdan ketishga qaror qildim.

sentences.text: Bekzod is working on **some** secret project, but he won't tell us about it.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **qandaydir** maxfiy loyiha ustida ishlayapti, lekin bu haqda bizga aytmayapti.

sentences.text: There was **some** accident on the motorway, so the traffic was terrible.
sentences.translation: Avtomagistralda **qandaydir** avariya bo'lgan ekan, shuning uchun tirbandlik dahshatli edi.

sentences.text: Let's have lunch together **some time** next week — I'll text you.
sentences.translation: Kelasi hafta **bir payt** birga tushlik qilaylik — sizga xabar yozaman.

examples.title: Mixed: **some**, **any** and their compounds
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: some va any ning barcha ma'nolari — bor narsa, noma'lum narsa, «istalgan», inkor va shart — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: Has **anyone** seen my keys? I'm sure I left them **somewhere** in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni **birortangiz** ko'rdingizmi? Ularni oshxonada **qayergadir** qo'yganimga aminman.

sentences.text: The doctor said I could eat **anything**, but **some** fruit would be better than chocolate.
sentences.translation: Shifokor **nima bo'lsa ham** yeyishim mumkinligini aytdi, lekin shokoladdan ko'ra **biroz** meva yaxshiroq ekan.

sentences.text: There aren't **any** flights to Bukhara on Sundays, but you can take **any** morning train.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kunlari Buxoroga **birorta ham** reys yo'q, lekin ertalabki **istalgan** poyezdga chiqsangiz bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **Some** of the comments under the article were rude, so the editor deleted them.
sentences.translation: Maqola ostidagi izohlarning **ba'zilari** qo'pol edi, shuning uchun muharrir ularni o'chirib tashladi.

sentences.text: Do you need **any** help with the presentation, or have you finished it?
sentences.translation: Taqdimot bo'yicha **biror** yordam kerakmi yoki tugatib bo'ldingizmi?

sentences.text: If **anybody** asks where I am, say I'm at the dentist.
sentences.translation: Agar **biror kishi** qayerdaligimni so'rasa, tish shifokoridaman deb ayting.

sentences.text: Madina didn't say **anything** at dinner — **something** must be wrong.
sentences.translation: Madina kechki ovqatda **hech narsa** demadi — **nimadir** bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak.

sentences.text: You can install the app on **any** phone, and it doesn't cost **anything**.
sentences.translation: Ilovani **istalgan** telefonga o'rnatishingiz mumkin, u **hech qancha** turmaydi.

sentences.text: Tom bought **some** new software, but it didn't solve **any** of our problems.
sentences.translation: Tom **bir nechta** yangi dastur sotib oldi, lekin u muammolarimizning **birortasini ham** hal qilmadi.

sentences.text: Is there **anything** I can do to help, or would you prefer to be alone for **some** time?
sentences.translation: Yordam berish uchun qila oladigan **biror narsam** bormi yoki **biroz** yolg'iz qolishni xohlaysizmi?
